input.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 16.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE AMOUNTS PAYABLE TO THIRD PARTIES UNDER THE INDEMNITIES PROVIDED PURSUANT TO ARTICLE 10, SECTIONS 16.1 AND 16.2 ABOVE; PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT THE FOREGOING LIMITATION OF LIABILITY SHALL NOT APPLY IN THE CASE OF GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
input.rationale: Section 16.5 is only a mutual waiver of special, indirect, punitive, incidental and consequential damages; its carve-outs operate against that waiver alone. No monetary or fee-based aggregate cap exists anywhere in the Agreement, leaving both Parties' direct exposure — including Ono's broad product-liability indemnity under Section 16.1 — unlimited, which fails the fallback on a material term. We add one new Section 16.7 at the fallback level: a mutual aggregate cap of 12 months' amounts payable by Ono, with each Party's indemnification obligations under this Agreement (including under Article 10 and Sections 16.1 and 16.2, matching the indemnity sources 16.5 itself identifies), breach of its confidentiality obligations, and gross negligence/willful misconduct expressly outside the cap. The caption at p0520 confirms Article X/10 is the confidentiality article. Section 16.5 and all other text are untouched. Preferred wording is not claimed (no USD 1,000,000 greater-of floor, "paid or payable" basis, data protection/security, fraud or other-party IP carve-outs, or payment-obligations exclusion).

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap of 12 months' amounts payable, with all indemnification obligations, confidentiality breaches and gross negligence/willful misconduct outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement disclaims consequential damages but sets no aggregate cap, so both Parties' direct liability is unlimited. We have added a mutual cap at 12 months' amounts payable by Ono as new Section 16.7, keeping each Party's indemnification obligations (including under Article 10 and Sections 16.1 and 16.2), breach of its confidentiality obligations and gross negligence/willful misconduct outside the cap; this is our fallback position.

ops.text: 16.7 Limitation of Liability. Except with respect to each Party's indemnification obligations under this Agreement (including under Article 10 and Sections 16.1 and 16.2), either Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article 10 (Confidentiality), and either Party's gross negligence or willful misconduct, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees and other amounts payable by Ono under this Agreement during the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the claim.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
